name: Team Gina
subject: Six polls show Gina in the lead
body:
These polls are painting a clear picture.| | | | Peter, Greg Abbott has _never_ trailed in the polls in any of his campaigns for governor. | | On Wednesday night, I faced Maggie Goodlander live on the big debate stage under the bright lights.

I went in with a game plan to lower your costs. She played the Blame Game all night.

So I kept count. Can you guess how many times she blamed Trump, for her own failures? **[Watch 30 sec: Maggie Goodlander plays the Blame Game](https://us.list-manage.com/gliMz3SIkKj?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)** I really hope that no viewers at home decided to turn this into a drinking game...
# **WATCH MY OTHER HIGHLIGHTS**
**The full debate.**
See it all, start to finish, and join the conversation in the comments.
[Watch the full debate](https://us.list-manage.com/fCm2rlVhnyW?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

**"Trump, not China."**
She said President Trump, not Communist China, is the greatest threat to America. I grew up under Mao, and I answered her.
[Watch the clip](https://us.list-manage.com/RXQmUJ3FE6s?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

My final pitch to Granite Staters, straight from the WMUR stage.
[Watch on WMUR](https://us.list-manage.com/1CtfRpqRI5I?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

**Before the cameras rolled.**
Team Lily turned out in force to wave signs in Manchester, and I made sure to thank every one of them before I walked in.
[Watch the sign wave](https://us.list-manage.com/t5Brutw4Z6w?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c) | [Watch my thank-you](https://us.list-manage.com/hJXpqIr6gaJ?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

You don't have to live in New Hampshire to help me win this race. Tonight, forward these clips to everyone you know in New Hampshire and ask them to vote on Tuesday. A text from someone they trust goes further than any ad.

body:
November 02, 2026 | Read Online ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmh45ozzzh6h88ko6krigh4dogv/08hwh9h24ekk4pslh5/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvNXF1dmg3aDBwNXp6emNwNXh4ZDUyYTk5MmR2cGx1bmhnMG1wbw== )

From Catherine
--------------

Support True the Vote’s work ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmh45ozzzh6h88ko6krigh4dogv/8ghqhoho8dxx88akh9/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvZG9uYXRl )

Hi Friend —

Well, here we are. The midterm run for the roses is almost at its end.

To the thousands who used Scan. Check. Protect. ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmh45ozzzh6h88ko6krigh4dogv/vqh3hrho60dd65bghl/aHR0cHM6Ly9zY2FuY2hlY2twcm90ZWN0Lm9yZw== ) to check your records, and everyone using 7 Votes ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmh45ozzzh6h88ko6krigh4dogv/l2hehmhlp2zzg5f6h0/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3Jn ) to help friends vote: thank you. And to all of you who are working with campaigns to make calls, knock on doors, and support everything from GOTV to ballot curing, thank you. You saw something worth doing, and you did it. That is how a country moves forward.

We’re hearing from Americans across the country who have discovered problems with their registrations and voting records. It’s maddening. It’s confounding. And amid the noise and chaos of politics, it can make people wonder whether their voices matter.

If someone you know feels that way, please share this with them:

Never mistake an imperfect system for a powerless people.

Even in our hardest moments — actually, especially in our hardest moments — America remains the greatest country on earth. And its strength comes from its people. From the neighbor who shows up, the friend who speaks out, the ordinary person who takes responsibility for something bigger than themselves. It always has been, and God willing always will be, about the people.

Liberty is messy. Free people disagree. We make mistakes. We struggle to put things right. The work is never finished. That’s reality, and it’s ok.

Sometimes the choices on the ballot are deeply disappointing. We can see those shortcomings clearly and still recognize that the outcomes are not all the same. Ask who will do less harm, protect more liberty, and leave us better able to keep working for change.

Your vote does not require your admiration. It requires your judgment. Cast it thoughtfully. Then hold the people you elect accountable.

The struggle between light and darkness reaches far beyond elections. We meet it every day, in the choices we make and the courage we find. God has given us work to do, neighbors to love, and reasons to hope.

Tuesday gives us an extraordinary opportunity: to bring millions of individual voices together and shape what happens next.

Yes, our elections need work. We must demand accuracy, pursue answers, and insist on accountability. And we must vote. The people we elect will help decide whether those changes happen.

Whatever road brought you here — hope, frustration, faith, or concern — the next step leads back to the ballot.

Politicians come and go. The enduring promise of America is that its people have a voice. Yours is valuable. Use it. Help someone else use theirs.

Keep the faith. Keep working. Keep reaching out.

Never, ever, ever quit.

Isaiah 6:8 is for you. Ephesians 6 FTW!

Ever onward —

P.S. Tuesday will come and go. We never stop. Long after the campaigns pack up and the headlines move on, we’ll still be here—pursuing public records, building tools, training citizens, and pressing for accountability.

That work takes resources. So does standing our ground through costly legal battles.

We bear those battle scars without regret, but we cannot carry this mission alone. Please make a donation to True the Vote today. We have the faith and the resolve. With your help, we’ll have the resources to keep going.

Help Us Keep Going ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmh45ozzzh6h88ko6krigh4dogv/8ghqhoho8dxx88akh9/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvZG9uYXRl )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmh45ozzzh6h88ko6krigh4dogv/l2hehmhlp2zzg5f6h0/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3Jn )
A message from someone you know moves people to vote in a way mass campaign messages can't.

* Texts from friends boost turnout. In a Columbia University study, a text from a friend raised turnout 8.3 percentage points. Mass automated texts average less than half a point.
* Small margins decide big elections. Just 187 votes decided a seat in Congress in 2024. Reaching even a few friends makes a real difference.
* Connection and a plan. What works is a friendly nudge from someone you trust, plus help making a real plan: when, where and how you'll vote.

Simple ways to help your seven: share their polling place, send date reminders, or offer a ride or a hand.

Sources: Schein, Green et al., Columbia University, friend-to-friend texting in the 2018 midterms; 2024 U.S. House results.

clean_body: November 02, 2026 | Read Online ( == ) From Catherine Support True the Vote’s work ( ) Hi Friend — Well, here we are. The midterm run for the roses is almost at its end. To the thousands who used Scan. Check. Protect. ( == ) to check your records, and everyone using 7 Votes ( ) to help friends vote: thank you. And to all of you who are working with campaigns to make calls, knock on doors, and support everything from GOTV to ballot curing, thank you. You saw something worth doing, and you did it. That is how a country moves forward. We’re hearing from Americans across the country who have discovered problems with their registrations and voting records. It’s maddening. It’s confounding. And amid the noise and chaos of politics, it can make people wonder whether their voices matter. If someone you know feels that way, please share this with them: Never mistake an imperfect system for a powerless people. Even in our hardest moments — actually, especially in our hardest moments — America remains the greatest country on earth. And its strength comes from its people. From the neighbor who shows up, the friend who speaks out, the ordinary person who takes responsibility for something bigger than themselves. It always has been, and God willing always will be, about the people. Liberty is messy. Free people disagree. We make mistakes. We struggle to put things right. The work is never finished. And that’s just what Trump’s political groups have spent since September. It’s not easy to compete against spending like this. But I've also seen something extraordinary this cycle: grassroots donors stepping up, again and again, to support EMILYs List women. I’ve watched your donations come in all cycle long, and I can tell you firsthand just how impactful this community has been. = | = Donald Trump and Elon Musk have spent more than $600 million to drown out supporters like you in races across the country — and their contributions have helped make this the most expensive election year in history. I'm sure when you open your email inbox, you're bombarded with emails from political campaigns or advocacy organizations, some of which you've never even heard of. Especially right now, with Election Day right around the corner.
I know it's a lot. But if taking back the Senate for Democrats and saving our Republic this November matters to you, I hope you keep reading this email. It's important.
Trump and MAGA are _out of control_.
We **MUST** regain Congressional power in the 2026 elections.
And I'm the only Democratic U.S. Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won.
**[So if regaining Congressional power and decisively rebuking the corrupt and failed Trump administration is worth it to you, donate to my reelection campaign today.](https://substack.com/redirect/1dd897fa-16f6-44f1-b67a-398794e5ebfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Let me explain why this race is so important:
My opponent, MAGA Mike Collins, is nothing but a Trump puppet. Whatever Donald Trump says, Mike Collins does. It doesn't matter what it is -- Mike doesn't think for himself.
If elected, his pathetic, child-like devotion to Donald Trump will only serve to further this administration's corrupt agenda.
That's why I need you in my corner right now. We can't afford to elect another Trump lackey to the Senate and let this crooked president and his corrupt administration continue to go unchecked.
**[Please, contribute to my campaign today. If you 're outraged by what's happening to this country, and you're ready to fight for the future of our Republic, this is something you can do right now that really makes a difference.](https://substack.com/redirect/1dd897fa-16f6-44f1-b67a-398794e5ebfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Jon

It’s also the most competitive race in the country. _Now the part I’d rather not put in writing._ Kiggans has had a money advantage from the start of this general election, and she’s kept it. MAGA poured $8 million into this district to beat me. I’ve sailed this stretch of water before. clean_body: The Wall Street Journal put our district at the center of the fight for the House. | | = The Wall Street Journal called my race a “high-stakes rematch.” I couldn’t agree more. And in two days, we settle it. Here’s what the WSJ got right: this district decides who runs the House. One of the country’s most respected analysts called VA-02 a bellwether. It’s also the most competitive race in the country. Now the part I’d rather not put in writing. Kiggans has had a money advantage from the start of this general election, and she’s kept it. MAGA poured $8 million into this district to beat me. I’ve sailed this stretch of water before. In 2022, I came up short against Jen Kiggans after far-right groups spent $6,059,677 against me. So this time, we’re doing things differently. We’re spending every penny in our budget to win this election, and we’re building a Voter Protection Fund to make sure that every vote gets counted. A few weeks ago I did what independent investigative journalists have a responsibility to do: I pulled the public records on a candidate for office and published what they showed. This time the candidate was Angie Nixon, Florida's Democrat nominee for the United States Senate.
Within days, House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries stood behind the US House of Representatives podium [to call me](https://substack.com/redirect/67a4a894-68dd-4493-84ae-4719574903a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a "stone-cold racist, pathological liar and nutjob" and demanded that Republicans denounce me. Maryland Gov. Wes Moore [accused me of "peddling racism" for clicks](https://substack.com/redirect/a81f7dce-73ae-47ec-b119-a9b5bf56ba7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Marjorie Taylor Greene announced she "1,000 percent" rejected my remarks. Nixon herself [told Newsweek](https://substack.com/redirect/7ac80613-3556-406b-a9a0-2161cc4daa85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "Charlie Kirk was a racist, just like Laura Loomer is."

Angie Nixon has [called President Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/1987edb9-0b80-4139-8d39-181eb408d4fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "nothing more than a racist white supremacist," adding, "I stand with @IlhanMN." When the Florida House took up a bill honoring Charlie Kirk after his assassination, she voted no and declared on the floor that the bill "feels like a bill brought straight from the KKK." When constituents objected, she launched into a profanity-laced rant: "I'm not gonna be too many more of your apes, dirty bitches" before turning it into a fundraising pitch: "Send me to DC! Donate."

She has written, "I can't wait until Donald Trump is arrested and held accountable. I will definitely vote to remove him after becoming Florida's next U.S. Senator." She supports D.C. statehood and packing the Supreme Court to usher in permanent Democrat control of the federal government. She opposes keeping biological men out of women's sports, posting "Trans Girls ARE Girls!", and boasts that she has taken her teenage daughter to lewd drag shows. When a Republican colleague filed a bill stating that Florida would not pay reparations to descendants of former slaves, she accused the party of finding it "convenient to demonize Black people." Every policy dispute, in Nixon's telling, is a racial attack, making every critic a bigot. This is the grievance machine Democrats hope will win them the election in November.

Hi Derek, it’s Roger Lau, and I’ll get right to it: I’m only sending this email to a small group of our most engaged supporters because [**I’m hoping I can count on you to chip in $7.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.gb4rMu&refcode=em_20261101_10189_fr&amount=7&t=7&akid=10189%2E22930333%2EUuEIjE)

First of all, **_thank you so much for your support of the DNC and the 10,000+ Democratic campaigns we’re fueling through Election Day.**_
The reason I’m reaching out is that our team set a $1 million fundraising goal to hit before Election Day. We set this goal because the last-minute door knocking, phone calls, and investments we make are going to be make-or-break.
As one of our most engaged supporters, I know you’ve probably been paying close attention to the polls, keeping up with Democratic campaigns in key battleground states, and that you most likely have a plan to vote — or maybe you’ve already cast your ballot. So I want to thank you for that, too.
But the truth is that a LOT of Americans are not as politically engaged as you are, Derek. And those folks are the ones we need to reach today, tomorrow, and up until the very last polling place closes its doors on Tuesday.
Reaching them and getting them to the polls is not easy, and it’s not cheap either. But we _have_ to do everything we can. Because losing to Donald Trump’s yes-men is not an option.
**Two more years of _this_ is not an option.**
[**I wish I didn’t have to ask you again, but the truth is that we won’t be able to honestly say that we did everything we could if we don’t hit this goal to fund our final get-out-the-vote operations. body:

# Critical Finance Director Update
---
|
---
| | Friends,
My name is Taylor, and I’m the Finance Director for JoAnna Mendoza, the retired Marine who’s running to flip Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District. I’m reaching out for a few reasons, but first and foremost, **thank you for your generous and continued support of the campaign**.
We are two days away from Election Day, and this race is closer than ever. Winning this seat isn't guaranteed, and what we do between now and Tuesday could make all the difference. But last month, our race rating changed from a Toss-Up to a Lean Democrat. While this is encouraging news, it has created an unexpected challenge: **some of our traditional fundraising support is drying up just as we enter the most expensive and consequential days of this campaign.**_**We still have a significant budget gap to close, and we cannot afford to slow down now.**_
Meanwhile, our opponents certainly aren't slowing down. Since the ratings change, dark-money interests and billionaires like Elon Musk have poured more than $2 million into this district to protect our opponent's seat. **They are doing everything they can to drown out our message, and we need the resources to fight back.**
I just sat down with our Campaign Manager to crunch the numbers, and the reality is that we need reinforcements one final time. We need an immediate infusion of support to keep our organizers knocking doors, our volunteers making calls, and our message reaching every last voter before polls close.
**A contribution today can help us reach voters we otherwise might not reach.**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Please consider chipping in whatever you can right now](https://us.list-manage.com/HJHVgaJWH3w?e=fea3203902&c2id=b00e5bb4cdbce8e5db7719846a7b67e1)
---
| | Together, we **will** be victorious on Tuesday and hold this lawless administration accountable. I hope you will join me during this final stretch, and please consider forwarding this email to anyone you think may be able to help too.
Thank you for your incredible support in sending our Marine to Congress.
Taylor

I didn’t plan to run for office again. But I couldn’t sit on the sidelines while Jon Husted and politicians like him in Washington kept failing the people of Ohio.
This campaign has never been about left versus right. It’s about who you fight for – and who you’re willing to stand up to.
When we fought to save the pensions of tens of thousands of Ohio retirees, we stood up to Wall Street and _won_. When we fought to cap insulin prices and bring down the cost of prescription drugs, we stood up to Big Pharma and _won._

Patrick here. Election Day is Tuesday, so I won't waste any time. Here's what our campaign is facing right now.
1. Early voting has ended in Ohio, and we need to mobilize millions more Ohioans tomorrow.
2. Our fundraising has slowed down. Dramatically.
3. If we don't turn that around, we will be forced to scale back our final push of voter outreach.

[CHIP IN TO HELP SHERROD WIN](https://substack.com/redirect/b1092f37-6260-4fb5-b35f-410462c5fdbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**SHORTFALL**
I don't know what other campaigns are experiencing or the full details of their fundraising, but the big picture appears to be that Democratic fundraising is stalling in the most critical phase of the midterms. ActBlue saw a steep drop-off yesterday, and today, our campaign's fundraising numbers are continuing to slow down. Take a look at this screenshot of the total amount raised by Democrats on ActBlue over the past few days:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b1092f37-6260-4fb5-b35f-410462c5fdbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
([Source: ActBlue Ticker Tracker](https://substack.com/redirect/c77f56d7-a772-4626-9509-11d66b2d32f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**I 'm not making this up. Democrats raised $2.57 million less online yesterday than the day before. That's a clear trend -- and it's heading in a bad direction.**
If people are starting to tune out, or worse, if they think this election is already decided, we're all in for a very rude awakening on Tuesday night.
Here's the truth: Our fundraising has slowed down at the worst time. We've committed budgets for our final push to get out the vote.
If we don't raise an additional $75K tonight to make up for [the shortfall we're experiencing on our Google and Facebook ads](https://substack.com/redirect/00a2cfb5-e682-4a1a-8f7e-a76880aca8d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we'll have no choice but to scale down our digital ads on the final day of voter outreach. It's our last chance to reach millions of Ohioans before they head to the polls on Tuesday.
**HERE 'S WHY WE CAN'T LET UP**
What we're seeing here internally confirms this race will be close. The polls in Ohio are still within the margin of error and we need to reach every last voter with Sherrod's message if we're going to win.
If you think this race is over, or if you have a friend or neighbor who does, let me lay this out as clearly as I can: **The worst possible thing to happen to our campaign right now is complacency. The other side isn 't slowing down -- the Vice President is flying in tomorrow to boost their momentum -- and neither can we.**
Ohio is a hard state for a Democrat to win - Donald Trump won the state by 11 points in 2024. We are fighting an uphill battle, and despite [encouraging early vote numbers for our campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/4cff3c0d-32a7-4c90-baee-85bfd7aaf2a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the turnout on Election Day could tilt the scale in either direction. At least 60% of total votes still need to be cast, and many Ohioans are still making up their minds.
We need to be prepared for our opponent's supporters to turn out at a high rate on Tuesday, which means our campaign needs to run through the tape and continue reaching every voter we can.
**The good news is we 've put ourselves in a position to be able to win on Tuesday. The work we've done thus far means that we are 100% in this fight.**
But winning is not a foregone conclusion. Not by a long shot.
I get that you're getting a lot of messages from candidates across the country right now. We've come too far and worked too hard to let this slip through our fingers now - and we have a strong shot at winning in Ohio.
A victory here could tip the scales for Senate control, too. **[Rushing a last-minute donation to our campaign is the most strategic investment you can make in the final sprint, and you have my word it 'll be put to use right away to get those last voters we need out to vote](https://substack.com/redirect/b1092f37-6260-4fb5-b35f-410462c5fdbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
I don't want to make a $75K cut to our mobilization budget on the final day before the election, but I might not have a choice. Your support today will help us hit the gas and run through the tape. I really, really hope we can count on you.

Not by a long shot. I get that you're getting a lot of messages from candidates across the country right now. We've come too far and worked too hard to let this slip through our fingers now - and we have a strong shot at winning in Ohio. A victory here could tip the scales for Senate control, too. . I don't want to make a $75K cut to our mobilization budget on the final day before the election, but I might not have a choice. Your support today will help us hit the gas and run through the tape. I really, really hope we can count on you. Patrick Eisenhauer Campaign Manager Before you click away! Republican spending in Ohio has reached $320 million, and Sherrod Brown is counting on your support to keep up. We can't outspend them, but we can outwork them. | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Friends of Sherrod Brown Friends of Sherrod Brown, 3867 West Market Street, Ste. 289 Akron, OH 44333 ? ?

body:
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=9905%2E582294%2EQtGfa8)
Let me lay out the facts of the race for you.
There are 2 days until the polls close. And unlike most other states, the vast majority of New Hampshire voters cast their ballot on Election Day.
**_So believe me when I say this final stretch truly matters._**
We’re being massively outspent, and every decision we make now could be the margin between a win and a loss.
I’ve been here before — I’ve won four times in one of the “swingiest” districts in the country. To win the whole Granite State, I know I’ll need you with me. New Hampshire voters are still making up their minds, and we have to stay competitive these last few days.

I wasn't planning on sending out a rant tonight. But when a Democrat like Haley Stevens endorses a Republican like Mike Rogers for the United States Senate two days before an election, somebody has to say what it means to actually believe in something bigger than yourself. Because she clearly doesn't know.
I just got home from a unity event on the North Side of Chicago that I helped organize. We brought every wing of the party into one room to thank our volunteers, remind people to vote, and talk about why we do this. I got to introduce our next Lieutenant Governor, Christian Mitchell, and Governor JB Pritzker.
My speech was 60 seconds long. All I said was that I was grateful to be in a room full of people I knew believed in our democracy. People who will fight for immigrant communities under attack by our own federal government. People who will work to make this state better and fight for the least of us against a fascist government that doesn't give a damn about any of us.
It was the kind of night that reminds you what this party is for. As Paul Wellstone used to say, politics is about the improvement of people's lives. Haley Stevens spent her day reminding us what it looks like to forget that.

* * *
When she endorsed Rogers over Abdul El-Sayed this morning, she didn't even pretend it was about policy. Not Israel. Not anything. She made it about herself. She's mad she got booed at the convention. She's mad she lost the primary. She's mad some trolls on the internet were mean to her. And apparently that's enough to throw away everything she ever claimed to stand for and hand her endorsement to a Republican.
That's not a principled stand. That's a sore loser with a microphone.
And let's be clear about who she's standing with. Mike Rogers will be a rubber stamp for every single thing Donald Trump wants in the back half of his term. Every ounce of corruption. Every ounce of destruction. Every scheme to rig this economy for a handful of billionaires and the corrupt assholes stuffing money into Trump's back pocket instead of yours.
This is a man who supports a nationwide abortion ban, and just got caught on tape saying so. A man who helped build the surveillance state and doesn't believe in your right to privacy. A man who has run the most racist Senate campaign I've seen in my two-decade career. The attacks on Abdul El-Sayed have been vile, and everyone who's watched this race knows it.
That's who Haley Stevens chose today.
Now, I didn't support Abdul in the primary. I was with Mallory McMorrow. And Mallory is exactly what it looks like to lose with dignity.
Mallory had every right to be angry. Fake polls were put out that hurt her fundraising. She took ugly, untrue attacks online. She could have nursed that grudge all the way to November. Instead, she endorsed Abdul right after the primary and went to work helping Democrats win up and down the ballot in Michigan.
That's how this is supposed to work. We fight it out in the primary. Then we rally around what we share and take on the people who are wrecking the global economy, waging an illegal war, and stealing billions from the American people. A lot of us who backed someone else in that race have spent the months since defending Abdul against racist attacks, because every Democrat is better than every Republican, especially with Donald Trump running the Republican Party.
That's the difference between a party and a grievance. Mallory understood it. Haley never did.
But here's the thing. Haley Stevens wanted to blow up this race. Instead, she blew up her own career and unified the Democratic Party in the process.
Today the establishment, the left, and everyone in between spoke with one voice. She may have done more to unite Democrats in the closing days of this election than anyone not named Barack Obama. Impressive. Thank you, Haley.
It's why Abdul is raising money hand over fist on ActBlue right now. It's why, according to my sources on the ground in Michigan, more people than ever are signing up to volunteer in the final 48 hours. It's why a new New York Times poll has Abdul up 11 over Rogers. I think it'll be closer than that, but that number is what Democratic enthusiasm looks like.

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3910%2E259176%2Et70ySA) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3910%2E259176%2Et70ySA)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/17725?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.11.01_Flanagan-Native_B4_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON_RS3&t=4&akid=3910%2E259176%2Et70ySA) Peter — in almost 250 years, there’s never been a Native woman serving in the US Senate. **It’s time to change that.**

I’m Peggy Flanagan, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Minnesota.

I am Ojibwe and a proud member of the White Earth Nation. My family is the Wolf Clan. The mission of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle.

I am the descendant of people who were forced off their land onto the White Earth reservation. I am the relative of residential boarding school survivors. I am the daughter of a man who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people.

I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government.

**Right now, there are _no_ Native voices in the US Senate. _If I win this race, we can change that._** [**It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. If you agree, will you pitch in $10 or whatever you can to power my campaign and Blue Amp Action and help me make history?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/18305?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.11.01_Flanagan-Native_B4_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON_RS3&t=5&akid=3910%2E259176%2Et70ySA) | [SPLIT $20 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/18306?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.11.01_Flanagan-Native_B4_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON_RS3&t=6&akid=3910%2E259176%2Et70ySA)

Too often, Native voices are ignored or erased in the halls of power..

That’s how we get awful so-called leaders like Donald Trump and J.D. Vance, who called Indigenous Peoples' Day a “fake holiday” and said that Native land was “enemy territory.”.

My Ojibwe name means 'Speaks in a Loud and Clear Voice woman.' So I’m using that voice to call out MAGA extremism — loudly and clearly.
But I can’t do it alone. I need your help to build a campaign strong enough to cut through the noise. [ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Let me level with you,
Derek:

Yesterday, we thought we had placed our final TV ad buy of the election.
Those ads just started running earlier today — and the plan was for the
rest of our budget to go toward our Get Out The Vote programs.

But we just made the call: We’re doing one more ad buy — and we need to
raise exactly $43,901 before 11PM tonight to push it through without any
cuts to our GOTV budget.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22833?amount=5&t=1001&akid=917%2E245147%2EYqrlbk ]I’ll tell you the thought process behind this decision in a moment, but
right now, I’m personally asking: Will you rush
$5 or whatever you can
before 11PM to make sure we reach every undecided voter we possibly can
here in battleground Pennsylvania?

After my opponent put a huge amount of money behind her AI-generated,
deepfake attack ad, we’ve heard the same thing from voters all across
Pennsylvania:

It stands out. And it could change the outcome of this entire election.

Derek, I don’t
need to tell you the stakes of this election. If we fall short on Tuesday
night, the far-right will control every state-level office in
Pennsylvania.

So come 2028, when Donald Trump tries to push his thumb on the scale here
in battleground Pennsylvania — or even try to overturn an entire election
just like he did in 2020? There could be no one to stop him.

Derek, the
stakes are too high to shrug our shoulders and just hope my opponent’s $5
million special interest cash influx won’t change this election. We need
to keep our momentum — not just until tonight. Or tomorrow. Or even
Tuesday morning. We need to keep our foot on the gas until the moment
polls close at 8PM Tuesday night.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22833?t=1002&akid=917%2E245147%2EYqrlbk ]I know this new ad buy is a big risk. But this team has stepped up so
many times before — and I know this time will be no different. But that
means every single person reading this message — yes, including
you, Derek —
takes that next step. Please, will you rush whatever you can before our
critical 11PM deadline?

All eyes are on Ohio right now. Everybody is watching to see whether a grassroots campaign built by working people can stand up to billionaires and corporate special interests.
A year ago, nobody thought we could win this race. The Washington lobbyist crowd thought Ohio was a safe Republican seat. Then we got in the race, and now the polls show we can win this thing – and flip the Senate along with it.
It hasn’t been easy. Every single day, National Republicans and Trump’s allies have been attacking us and trying to stop our momentum. It’s been tough, but we’ve fought through it. I know it probably wears on you too.
You’ve stood with me the whole time. Thank you.
I didn’t get into this to give half an effort. I got in this to win – because Ohioans deserve better. If we wake up Wednesday morning with anything left in the tank, or in the bank, then we didn’t do everything we could.
So here’s the only thing standing between us and finishing the job: the resources to fire on all cylinders every hour between now and the polls closing on Tuesday evening. Every door, every call, every last voter.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: My mind is racing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
I know it's late on a Sunday night, Peter, but I’m still up because my mind is racing. I can’t stop thinking about the last-minute ads flooding into our race.
**Mike Rogers, the biggest MAGA spenders, and AIPAC are spending $157,000,000 to try to beat us. That is a lot of zeroes.**
But despite how scary that sounds, I still believe deep in my bones that we can – and _we will_ – win this thing in two days. Here’s why:
Republican megadonors and AIPAC have run this exact playbook before. And they’re doing it right now all across the country. They spend their millions trying to bury their opponents — and in almost every one of those races, one of two scenarios plays out:
1. When a campaign has the resources to tell its own story and break through the noise, these attack ads don't land.
2. But when a campaign runs dry, gets overwhelmed, and can't respond, that's when the negative ads seal their fate.

That’s the choice. Whether we get to defy the odds once again in exactly 48 hours isn't complicated. **Everything we’ve worked towards together will come down to whether we have enough money to keep running our final ads to reach our voters** _**right as they head to the polls.**_
I wouldn't be writing to you this late if I didn't believe what you do tonight still matters to what happens in this race.
So please, if you can pitch in $5 or any amount so we can keep our ads on the air for these final, crucial 48 hours, it would make a real difference. Can I count on your support?

Here's how to make sure your ballot counts.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/eUm1m7DklE7?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4)
| | | | Peter, In 48 hours, the polls close. **This race is going to come down to turnout – which voters actually get their ballots in. So here's my ask today: make sure your vote counts, and then make sure three friends' ballots count too.** | | [FIND A DROP BOX](https://us.list-manage.com/Yp1o7OtLnSm?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4)
---

**Use a drop box.** After thousands of ballots in the August primary went uncounted over postmark problems, my advice is simple: don't wait on the mail. Drop boxes are open until 8 p.m. on Tuesday, and you don't need a stamp.
– Vote the whole ballot, front and back.
– Sign the envelope.
– Drop it off by 8 p.m. Tuesday.
**Already voted? Check that your ballot was received at[VoteWA.gov](https://us.list-manage.com/rmroCBdbSAq?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4).** If your county tells you there's a problem with your signature, fill out the cure form right away so your vote is counted.
Thank you,
Carmela

I know this district like the back of my hand. I’ve spent years working alongside the hardworking families of Osceola, Orange, and Polk counties. name: Angie Nixon (via Democrats.org)
subject: They blame you. Not the corporations.
body:
It's time someone said it out loud [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10192%2E22930333%2EFj8IRA)
---
Derek, it's Angie Nixon, Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate. Here's a con that's been running for years, and it's time someone said it out loud. Politicians like Ashley Moody keep getting richer in office. Meanwhile, the rest of us are working harder than ever and still can't get ahead. And when people ask why, here's the answer they get: you should have worked harder. Not the corporation that underpays you. Not the executives who padded their own bonuses while freezing your wages. Not the politicians who wrote the laws that let them do it. You. That's the con. Blame the nurse, the warehouse worker, the teacher, the home health aide, for a system that was rigged against them before they ever walked in the door. I've watched this happen my whole life. My mom worked two jobs just to keep us afloat, not because she didn't work hard enough, but because the system was never built for people like us to get ahead in the first place. name: Adam Hamilton
subject: Trump just stepped off the stage
body:
We need all hands on deck to fight back
|
#
| | | | | Hi, Peter – Roy Cooper here. My friend Adam Hamilton is running for U.S. Senate over in Kansas, and he needs our support. If you can, [**_I hope you'll split a donation between our grassroots campaigns._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19681?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1740&amount=5&t=7&akid=5281%2E124072%2EEYrd7n)

If you'd no longer like to receive these partner emails, [**_you can opt out here._**](https://act.roycooper.com/signup/unsub-tandems/?t=8&akid=5281%2E124072%2EEYrd7n)
---|---
Peter, **
President Trump just stepped off the stage at his Kansas rally for Roger Marshall — and we’re already preparing for more attacks to come our way. [**_I’ll share more in a second, but if you understand exactly how urgent this moment is, with ballots being cast _right now_ , will you pitch in whatever you can spare between my campaign and Roy Cooper to fight back and hit our $250,000 goal?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19681?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1740&amount=5&t=9&akid=5281%2E124072%2EEYrd7n)**
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19757?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1740&amount=5&t=10&akid=5281%2E124072%2EEYrd7n)
---
Moments ago, the president invited Roger Marshall to join him on stage — a powerful platform he used to spread more lies about me and our grassroots movement. It’s a deliberate attempt to turn the narrative against us, slow our momentum and bail out his flailing campaign.
Here’s the honest truth: **Washington insiders are panicking.** They know we have what it takes to win this race. That’s why major GOP super PACs have already spent $30 million against us. That’s why JD Vance was here on Monday and why President Trump came back to the Sunflower State today.
But here’s what we didn’t hear Roger Marshall talking about today:
* $6 diesel squeezing Kansas farmers
* Harmful tariffs hurting small businesses
* Endless wars raising the costs of everyday goods for families
* The decision to slash SNAP benefits and Medicaid that Kansans rely on
_These are the issues on the minds of hardworking Kansans — which Sen. Marshall would know if he ever bothered to listen._ Instead, he has been a yes-man for his party and the president, failing to do the No. 1 job of a senator: to be a champion for the people you represent.
**Now, he asked the president to swoop in to try and save his campaign — and the visit gives a green light to outside groups to spend even more against me in this race.**
If we don’t immediately respond, we risk persuadable voters being misled by our opponents at the most critical time. _Voting is already underway — we don't have a second to waste._
**You’ve been a critical member of this team already, and we need you to step up and make a contribution to help us fight back today. We’re _so close_ , and we can’t afford to lose momentum now.** [**_Please, give whatever you can spare right now to finally end the chaos and corruption in Washington and help us by splitting a donation between our campaign and Roy Cooper._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19681?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1740&amount=5&t=11&akid=5281%2E124072%2EEYrd7n)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Adam Hamilton and Cooper Victory Fund will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19682?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1740&amount=5&t=12&akid=5281%2E124072%2EEYrd7n)
---

---

Thank you for helping us respond,
Adam Hamilton

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

subject: Panicking at the last second.
body:
They see the same polls you do. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10181%2E22930333%2EPr25Hy)
---
Derek, Republicans are panicking. They see the same polls you do. They’re shifting resources from races they were counting on winning to races they _never imagined_ could be in play. **Suddenly, they’re scared they could lose statewide in states like Kansas and Mississippi.** That’s why they’re investing **_billions of dollars_** into a desperate last attempt to hold on to their majorities in the House and Senate. They’re begging for cash infusions from their billionaire friends to save them. And they’re hoping that Democrats will see promising polling as permission to sit back and relax. We’re not going to let that happen, Derek. We’re running out of time to reach voters and convince them to vote for Democrats in battleground races, so we have to pull out all the stops in these final 24 hours. We’re not going to leave any stone unturned — _and this final push is going to be expensive._ While Republicans count on late cash infusions from their billionaire sponsors to get them through this final stretch, we’re counting on you. Over 99% of the DNC’s contributions come from grassroots supporters like you. Regular people — teachers, nurses, and retirees — chipping in what they can, $10 or $20 at a time. **And when Democrats take back the House and the Senate tomorrow, that army of grassroots support will be why.** **But we can’t rest yet. name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: My honest answer
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3859%2E251025%2EZjnt_4 ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3859%2E251025%2EZjnt_4 ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

If you’re wondering where I am right now, the answer is that I'm making
every stop I can. We’re hitting up Ypsilanti, Flint, Royal Oak, and
Detroit today, but before the day gets away from me, I wanted to write to
you myself.

Anyone seeing this email, maybe even you, might ask themselves the
following question: “Isn’t it too late for my $10 to make a
difference?”

Here’s my honest answer: No. Not even close.

Our campaign doesn’t stop until the polls close tomorrow night. Every
dollar that comes in between now and then goes straight into our final
hours. We’re talking about things like:

* Filling up gas tanks so our volunteers can drive over to a few more
neighborhoods and knock on a few more doors
* Scaling up our digital ads budget just a little more so our message
reaches voters scrolling on their phones on the way to the polls
* Keeping our phone banks running through the final hours so we can
remind one more voter that tomorrow is the day

None of these are huge expenses on their own. But I’ve seen how close this
race is. I’ve met the voters who are still making up their minds. Some of
them will decide based on one conversation at their door tomorrow. I want
to make sure we’re there for that conversation.

A few more doors. A few more ads. A few more calls.

A few more voters who show up to cast their ballot in a neck-and-neck
race.

Remember: by the time this thing is over, the MAGA mega donors supporting
Mike Rogers will have spent over $157 million trying to get their guy in
the Senate.

This is our last chance to defeat them using the advantage MAGA
Republicans couldn’t buy: hundreds of thousands of grassroots supporters
who refuse to sit this one out.

We beat the odds by making it to this moment. Will you help us make
history again?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261102-1-ak.6TOmmc&amount=10&refcode=em20261102-3857&t=1004&akid=3859%2E251025%2EZjnt_4 ]Peter, this
is one of the last times I’ll ever ask: will you chip in
$10, or whatever you can, right now to power our final push
until polls close tomorrow night?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261102-1-ak.6TOmmc&amount=10&refcode=em20261102-3857&t=1023&akid=3859%2E251025%2EZjnt_4 ]Donate $10 ››

I’m heading back out on the trail, with the hope that while I’m out there,
folks like you can chip in just a few more bucks before this race is
decided. Words can’t express how grateful I am for your support.

Let’s do this together.

Abdul

[ Abdul ]Abdul El-Sayed

It’s about investing in our schools, strengthening our healthcare system, and making life more affordable for hardworking families across New Mexico. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, quick and
important:

If you still have a mail-in ballot sitting at home that you haven’t
returned, do not put it in the mail tonight.

In Pennsylvania, a mail-in ballot has to be received by your county
election office by 8PM tomorrow, not just postmarked. So if it’s still
sitting on your kitchen counter, the only way to make sure your vote is
counted is to hand it in.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22994?t=1001&akid=920%2E245147%2ERtTGll ]Click here to find your county election office and hours to return your
ballot in person >>

Do that first. Then, if you’re able, please chip in any amount to power
our final hours of voter outreach. [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22986?t=1002&akid=920%2E245147%2ERtTGll ]$15, $5, $1, no amount is too small.

There are thousands of Pennsylvanians in exactly this situation right now
— holding onto a ballot they meant to send two weeks ago, who might not
know it’s too late to put it in the mail. And every person we’re still
able to reach in these final hours is a vote that would otherwise go
uncounted.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22986?t=1003&akid=920%2E245147%2ERtTGll ]Derek, there’s
too much on the line to sit this election out. Please make a donation of
any size right now to help us make sure every last voter in Pennsylvania
makes their voice heard by tomorrow night.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

Shapiro for Pennsylvania

I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor.
| Peter,
**I know your inbox is probably overflowing right now with politicians begging for your hard-earned money using every scare tactic in the book.**
_I truly hate having to send messages like this, but I really appreciate your time!_
My last message didn't get the response I was hoping for, and now I'm starting to feel like we're falling behind. We can't keep fighting if we don't have the resources to keep the lights on and pay my amazing staff.
Let me take a second to re-introduce myself: _**My name is Jen Kiggans.**_
I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom.
---
[](https://trk.email.repdailyred._6Wjyx049tWHC7A)
---
And that is exactly __**WHY**__ I ran for Congress in 2022.
I knew that I needed to step up and do my part to make sure that my four kids inherit a GREAT America!
Against all odds, we flipped Virginia's 2nd District **RED** in one of the tightest, must-win races in the entire country. But elections have serious consequences and these radical Left Democrats are not going to give up without a fight.
Now, National Democrats and Left-leaning Super PACs are raking in millions to attack me and take back the House this year. They want to turn our great commonwealth into California AND my far-Left opponent announced she raised over $1.6 MILLION in the last quarter alone.
_They will stop at absolutely nothing to win._
So today, I'm recruiting YOU to join my mission to save our country from the Democrats' grasp once and for all. That is why I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor. **[Will you chip in just a few dollars to support a former Navy pilot on this critical mission to SAVE OUR GOP HOUSE MAJORITY?](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)**
---
| [ JOIN JEN'S MISSION >>](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)
---
| [CHIP IN RIGHT NOW!](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)
---
As a Navy Vet, I've never turned away from a tough fight, and trust me, I won't start now. But to keep our House Majority intact and continue fighting for our country's future, I really need your support!
Thank you all so very, very much!
\- Jen Kiggans

I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America's success!

body:

|
#
| | | | | Hi Peter – Roy Cooper here. My friend Sherrod Brown is running for U.S. Senate over in Ohio, and he needs our support. If you can, [**_I hope you'll split a donation between our grassroots campaigns.**_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19285?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1672&amount=5&t=7&akid=5133%2E124072%2EYLBWsm)

---|---
I know you’ve heard a lot from my team and me recently, so please forgive me. Sending this email to you is the last thing I want to do, but I have to.**
We’re falling short of our daily fundraising goal, so [**_I need you to split a donation between my campaign and Roy Cooper right now to help us get back on track. There’s only one day left until Election Day, so please, don’t delay._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19285?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1672&amount=5&t=9&akid=5133%2E124072%2EYLBWsm)
Our campaign has been mounting a full court press for months. We went up on TV with ads early to spread our message. We also invested heavily in our field program to start having meaningful conversations with voters as soon as we could. In a race this important, with the stakes so high, we aren’t letting a moment go to waste.
**But this also means that we’re spending through a significant amount of resources.** We’ve even overshot our budget in some places to make sure we’re reaching and persuading the Ohioans who will decide this election.
Folks are clearly resonating with our message, but crypto's most powerful super PAC is flooding Ohio with another dark money cash infusion to run vicious attack ads that lie about me and my record. **This will turn the tides against us, unless we can raise more money and reach more people – quickly. And with early voting underway in Ohio, every day we don’t scale up means thousands of voters we could miss.**
[**_That’s why this goal is so crucial, so I have to ask: Will you split $5 or whatever you can between me and Roy Cooper to help us hit our goal before the midnight deadline, win in Ohio, and flip the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19285?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1672&amount=5&t=10&akid=5133%2E124072%2EYLBWsm)
We can't retreat in the face of the data center developers and crypto bros. Thank you.
Sherrod

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

body:
my story

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=13697%2E400544%2EkUre2k)
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/18570?refcode=jtk1469-fr-nd&t=2&akid=13697%2E400544%2EkUre2k)
Friend, Election Day is TOMORROW — and this is one of your last chances to help us cross the finish line. I’m up against a Republican opponent funded by many of the same donors who helped elect Donald Trump. **[Will you rush $5 right now to help us win this race?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/18570?refcode=jtk1469-fr-nd&amount=5&t=3&akid=13697%2E400544%2EkUre2k)** If you’d like to know more about why your donation today is so critical in these final hours, let me briefly share why I’m running for Governor and what’s at stake in this election.
| | [Pitch in $5 >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/18570?refcode=jtk1469-fr-nd&amount=5&t=4&akid=13697%2E400544%2EkUre2k)
---
I come from generations of resilient and fierce Pueblo women.

It’s thanks to these women — like my mom, who served in the U.S. Navy, raised four kids as a military wife, and then devoted 25 years to Indian education at the Bureau of Indian Affairs — that I summoned the courage to run for office.

It led me to become one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and, later, the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. In those roles, I fought to expand access to healthcare, protect our public lands, and stand up for the communities and families who deserve a government that works for them.

I carry the strength of the women who came before me into every fight, and I know there is still so much more work to do.

History has shown us that there’s nothing we can’t accomplish if we work together. **No state in America has ever elected a Native American woman as Governor — but with your support, I know we can change that.**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
# [](https://act.janepac.com/go/30?t=1&akid=15%2E6803%2EcC2LvM)
Welcome to the November edition of _**The JanePAC Monthly**_.
Election Day is tomorrow! As we enter the final push, we’ve been thinking of the leaders whose courage paved the way for the movement we’re building today. **Few embody that spirit more than labor activist and civil rights icon Dolores Huerta.**
‘ _Si se puede_ ’ was her credo. _Yes, We Can!_ lifted up our spirits to a world where nothing was off the table for workers. Dolores was often the only woman in the negotiating rooms and had true power. It certainly wasn’t given to her. She seized it in a world where women were expected to serve and remain silent.
She stood in her power and became the union’s key negotiator. It was Dolores who won contracts that went far beyond wages to include healthcare, retirement, benefits, safer working conditions. She was one of the first to raise the banner of environmental justice, and a huge inspiration for our founder and president Jane Fonda. Her fierce, fighting spirit lives on in each of us. **We pledge to carry on Dolores’ mantra._Si se puede, siempre!_**
* * *
**200 HUGS FROM JANE**
Electing leaders who fight for working people, not corporations will take all of us. That’s why our endorsed climate champions are out in the field, talking to voters, knocking on doors, and building the grassroots power we need to win. **And Jane is right there alongside them:**
**In fact, she gave out 200 hugs to volunteers at a canvass for JanePAC-endorsed Tina Kotek** , running for reelection as Oregon’s Governor.
Have you cast your ballot? The more of us who turn out, the harder we are to ignore.
Join Jane and make your plan to vote today. **[Look up your polling location, check your ballot details, and get ready at Vote411.](https://act.janepac.com/go/49?t=3&akid=15%2E6803%2EcC2LvM)**
**[Find your polling place ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/49?t=4&akid=15%2E6803%2EcC2LvM)**
* * *
**A MOMENT OF GRATITUDE 🙏 **
Before voting ends tomorrow, we want to say **thank you.**
Every movement has been defined by everyday people deciding the status quo is unacceptable and doing something about it. This fight is no different.
Together, we’re proving that the many can beat the money:
* **Over 60,000 grassroots contributions** standing together against corporate polluter cash.
* **Over 250 climate champions** elected nationwide since 2022.
* **Over 260 endorsements this year** where just a handful of votes will decide who controls our city councils, statehouses, and public lands.

We’re on the brink of making history tomorrow because of you. Big Oil will never fight for our future — it’s up to us to elect leaders who have the moral courage to hold corporate polluters and greedy billionaires accountable.

As we enter the final push, we’ve been thinking of the leaders whose courage paved the way for the movement we’re building today. It certainly wasn’t given to her. She seized it in a world where women were expected to serve and remain silent. She stood in her power and became the union’s key negotiator. It was Dolores who won contracts that went far beyond wages to include healthcare, retirement, benefits, safer working conditions. She was one of the first to raise the banner of environmental justice, and a huge inspiration for our founder and president Jane Fonda. Her fierce, fighting spirit lives on in each of us. We pledge to carry on Dolores’ mantra.Si se puede, siempre! 200 HUGS FROM JANE Electing leaders who fight for working people, not corporations will take all of us. subject: A personal note from me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
He doesn’t dwell on it, but I want you to understand what this means to people.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=9914%2E582294%2EsdZQtQ)
Hi friend,
It’s Vann, Chris’s husband. I don’t often write to you, but I recently read something I wanted to share.
The New York Times published a profile of Chris with the headline: _“His Election Could Decide Senate Control. He Could Make History, Too.”_
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261102_3.AcEUO6&refcode=em20261102-3&t=2&akid=9914%2E582294%2EsdZQtQ)
**Both halves of that headline are true. But Chris is only focused on the first one.**
That’s who he is. When the _Times_ asked him about making history, he said he isn’t thinking much about it, that he’s focused every day on the people of New Hampshire. On the trail it’s the same: affordable health care, high prices, corruption in Washington. He means every word. It’s one of the many reasons I love him.
But I’m his husband, not his campaign manager, so I get to say the other part out loud: **If Chris wins tomorrow, he will be the first out gay man ever to serve in the United States Senate.**
Here’s how long this has taken: Barney Frank became the first member of Congress to come out voluntarily in 1987. It took another 25 years for an openly gay candidate, Tammy Baldwin, to win a Senate seat. And in the entire history of that chamber, **_not one out gay man has ever served there._**
Chris could change that. That matters. It matters to Chris and me, and it matters to people all across this country who have never once seen themselves in that room.
**[Tomorrow we can make that history real. If this moment means something to you too, will you chip in to help Chris win?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261102_3.AcEUO6&refcode=em20261102-3&t=3&akid=9914%2E582294%2EsdZQtQ)**
When Chris was growing up in Manchester, he attended one of the biggest public high schools in the state, and as far as he knew, there wasn’t a single out student there. No gay-straight alliance. Nobody to look at and think, _that could be me._ He has said he’s now living a life he didn’t think was possible back then.
He came out in college, returned home, and ran for the State House at age 22 without hiding who he was. New Hampshire embraced him then, and it’s embracing him now. Chris likes to point to our state motto, “Live Free or Die.” To him it means people here, whatever their politics, want their neighbors to be free to be themselves. I’ve watched that play out in coffee shops, at town halls, and on front porches across this state.
And Chris has never been quiet about the fight itself. In 2004 his very first speech on the House floor was against a bill to block New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages. He called it what it was. He lost that vote. Five years later New Hampshire legalized marriage equality, six years before it became the law of the land nationwide. In Congress he became co-chair of the Equality Caucus and has championed bills to expand civil rights protections for LGBTQ Americans and to restore benefits for veterans who were discharged just for being who they are.
**I’ve never met anyone more patient about the long game or more stubborn about winning it.**
That’s why it meant so much to me that the _Times_ wrote about a young organizer who said that in part because of Chris, he came out to his family and friends and found out the people around him love him for exactly who he is.
There are kids in high schools all over this country right now walking the same hallway Chris did, unsure whether there will be a place for them wherever they want to end up. They’re watching this race whether anyone tells them to or not. **If Chris wins they’ll see there’s no ceiling on what you can achieve based on who you love.**
Somersworth’s Mayor Gerding told the _Times_ this is the kind of milestone you’d want to sing from the rooftops. I agree. **So consider this email my rooftop.**
And it couldn’t come at a more important moment. A few weeks ago the Vice President mocked a Democratic Senate candidate by falsely suggesting he was gay, as if that were an insult. As Chris put it, cynical attacks on the LGBTQ community have gone mainstream, and a lot of people are scared about where this country is headed. **A win in New Hampshire would be a loud answer.**
Republicans know what’s at stake, too: **This race could decide who controls the Senate.** If we win New Hampshire, Democrats can flip the Senate and finally put a check on this administration. If we lose Republicans keep their grip on the majority, and this era of chaos rolls on. And they’re spending over $67 million to do it.
**[This race is about more than Chris. It’s about the future of our country. So I’m asking you to make a contribution in the final stretch:](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261102_3.AcEUO6&refcode=em20261102-3&t=4&akid=9914%2E582294%2EsdZQtQ)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261102_3.AcEUO6&amount=5&refcode=em20261102-3&t=23&akid=9914%2E582294%2EsdZQtQ)**
**Tomorrow we have a chance to take back the Senate majority _and_ make history on the same night.**
I’m so proud of Chris. I’m so proud of New Hampshire. Thank you for standing with us.
Vann Bentley
(Chris’s husband)
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20261102-3&t=24&refcode2=9914_582294_sdZQtQ&akid=9914%2E582294%2EsdZQtQ)**

body:
Join a Ground Truth canvass or sign up for a virtual phone bank today or tomorrow!
#
Hi there,
**Election Day is tomorrow—and there’s still time to make an impact.**
The Swing Left community has been working toward this moment all year—knocking doors, making calls, sending texts, sharing political content on social media, and making grassroots donations to help Democrats win the races that will decide control of Congress.
We couldn’t be more grateful for the hard work Swing Left volunteers and donors across the country have put in, and we hope you feel that same pride in the work you’ve done.
**But our work isn’t done yet. Although Election Day is tomorrow, it’s _still_ not too late to make a difference.**
Some of the House and Senate races we’re targeting are expected to be incredibly close, and in races like these, a few hundred votes can decide the outcome. Every voter we reach between now and the moment polls close could be the one who tips the balance.
That’s why we have opportunities to help today and tomorrow, no matter where you live or how much time you have.
1. [**You can join a Ground Truth canvass near you.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3247?t=1&akid=3375%2E1562180%2Ep1Ho24) Knock doors in a swing race and have real, face-to-face conversations with voters, one of the most effective ways to get people to the polls.

2. [**You can join a campaign-run virtual phone bank from anywhere in the country, at almost any time.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3248?t=2&akid=3375%2E1562180%2Ep1Ho24) All you need is a computer.

Whichever volunteer opportunity you choose to do in these final hours, thank you. This community has shown up again and again, and we’re grateful for the work we’ve done together.
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. Every voter we reach between now and the moment polls close could be the one who tips the balance. That’s why we have opportunities to help today and tomorrow, no matter where you live or how much time you have. 1. Knock doors in a swing race and have real, face-to-face conversations with voters, one of the most effective ways to get people to the polls. 2. All you need is a computer. Whichever volunteer opportunity you choose to do in these final hours, thank you. This community has shown up again and again, and we’re grateful for the work we’ve done together. — The Swing Left Team Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power. Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. | | | ---|---|---|--- Paid for by Swing Left, , not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. In the northern part of our district, "The Depot" is universally understood to refer to the Anniston Army Depot. It's a big deal. Just under 4,000 people work there, most of them U.S. Government employees, and it's a major economic asset to five counties.
The Depot was established in 1940 on more than 10,000 acres just outside the Calhoun County seat. It was built to store ammunition, and very few people outside the US Army and North Alabama had heard of The Depot until 2003, when it was designated as one of the facilities where the United States would destroy its chemical weapons stockpiles. That mission ended in 2011.
When I started campaigning, I almost instantly heard, "You know, Mike Rogers saved The Depot." The story goes that if Mike Rogers had not been in Congress, some evil politician, probably a Democrat, would have closed The Depot, and thousands of jobs would have been lost. In a community that had already lost Fort McClellan, Rogers saving The Depot would have been a VERY big deal. There's just one problem: it never happened. ....

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
The day is here. Tomorrow is election day, a chance for us to make history and change the direction of our nation.
I have seen a change over the last year. Now, everywhere we go, people want to stop and talk about our ideas and policies. Some are still entrenched in their thinking, but so many others want to engage.
And I've heard many, many times, "I've never voted for a Democrat before, but I'm going to vote for you."
I want to thank everyone who has been a part of this campaign. Your support from day 1 has been the backbone of our efforts. You have held us up through some hard times and stepped up before we even knew to ask for help. We would not be here without you.
This campaign was born on June 15, 2025, the day after the first No Kings protest. That was 505 days ago. I always knew I would be writing this at the bottom of a newsletter at some point, but now that it's here, it feels strange.
We are 1 day away from the general election.
Be Well. Thank You All.
We will talk soon.

clean_body: You Don't Want to Miss This | | | | | == | | | CAMPAIGN UPDATE | | | | | Things To Remember: Recheck your polling place here: == Make sure you have a photo ID. If you are told you are not eligible to vote, DO NOT LEAVE YOUR PRECINCT. ASK FOR A PROVISIONAL BALLOT. CAST YOUR VOTE, THEN ASK FOR INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO CERTIFY YOUR BALLOT. They must provide you with a provisional ballot and instructions on how to certify it. DO NOT LEAVE YOUR PRECINCT WITHOUT VOTING. If you're not comfortable with anything... anything at all... ask to speak with the precinct supervisor. Explain the problem. Don't leave until you're satisfied. Again, if you're not comfortable, ask to speak to the precinct supervisor. Finally, keep this number: 1-833-468-6832. It is the voter hotline at "I Will Vote," and they support voting in Alabama. Call that number if you have any worries. Then DM me on social media. I'll keep an eye on things as best I can. | | | MAKING HISTORY | | THE WEEK AHEAD | | Sign Waving and Happy Hour Park near El Patron Restaurant in Tiger Town, we will wave signs on the corner of Fredrick Rd and 280, then we'll have Happy Hour at El Patron, first round is on Lee. 🗓️ November 2 🕓 4:00 P.M. The corner of Fredrick Road and 280, Auburn AL | | | VOTE!!! Bring your yard sign and add it to the others at least 30 feet from the door. 🗓️ November 3 🕓 7:00 A.M. -7:00 P.M. 📍 Find your polling place on the Alabama Secretary of State Website == | | | | THE WEEK BEHIND | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | In Case You Missed It | | BLOG POSTS | == In the northern part of our district, "The Depot" is universally understood to refer to the Anniston Army Depot. It's a big deal. Just under 4,000 people work there, most of them U.S. Government employees, and it's a major economic asset to five counties. The Depot was established in 1940 on more than 10,000 acres just outside the Calhoun County seat. It was built to store ammunition, and very few people outside the US Army and North Alabama had heard of The Depot until 2003, when it was designated as one of the facilities where the United States would destroy its chemical weapons stockpiles. That mission ended in 2011. When I started campaigning, I almost instantly heard, "You know, Mike Rogers saved The Depot." The story goes that if Mike Rogers had not been in Congress, some evil politician, probably a Democrat, would have closed The Depot, and thousands of jobs would have been lost. In a community that had already lost Fort McClellan, Rogers saving The Depot would have been a VERY big deal. There's just one problem: it never happened. .... | == | A Few Things to Think About | | | | | FROM THE NEWS | == Three Democratic candidates, along with the wife of Lee McInnis, joined to talk about their experience and what they would like to happen in their respective offices if elected. | A CALL TO ACTION | This won't be a year when we can sit back and expect everyone else to do the work. If you want to change the direction of the country, you have to get into the game. If you can help us with any of these efforts, drop us a note, and we will be in touch. Here is what you can do to help us win in November: | Make a plan to vote: Tell everyone you know to vote, offer rides to the polls, THEN VOTE. | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | The day is here. Tomorrow is election day, a chance for us to make history and change the direction of our nation. I have seen a change over the last year. Now, everywhere we go, people want to stop and talk about our ideas and policies. Some are still entrenched in their thinking, but so many others want to engage. And I've heard many, many times, "I've never voted for a Democrat before, but I'm going to vote for you." I want to thank everyone who has been a part of this campaign. Your support from day 1 has been the backbone of our efforts. You have held us up through some hard times and stepped up before we even knew to ask for help. We would not be here without you. This campaign was born on June 15, 2025, the day after the first No Kings protest. That was 505 days ago. I always knew I would be writing this at the bottom of a newsletter at some point, but now that it's here, it feels strange. We are 1 day away from the general election. Be Well. Thank You All. We will talk soon. Lee | | | | == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- == | == ---|--- mailto:?subject=The%20Latest%20News%20from%20the%20Campaign&body= | mailto:?subject=The%20Latest%20News%20from%20the%20Campaign&body= ---|--- | == == == | | | | Lee McInnis 4 Alabama | PO Box 111 | Opelika, AL 36801 US | | | | | | |
