body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek,

Tomorrow, Pennsylvania will send a message
to Donald Trump — and the whole country will be watching.

Here’s the part most folks don’t think about: That message doesn’t get
written by pundits, or polls, or anybody on TV tomorrow night.

It gets written by the Pennsylvanians who decide to show up.

If we turn out every single supporter we’ve got, we’ll send a message loud
and clear that the good people of Pennsylvania reject Donald Trump’s
chaos, cruelty, and corruption.

But if we don’t? His handpicked nominee takes this office.

There are thousands of Pennsylvanians who are on board with our vision and
still might not vote tomorrow. Not because they changed their minds. But
because life gets in the way. A shift runs long. A kid gets sick. Nobody
reminds them that polls are open until 8PM.

So every person we reach is a vote we can earn — and every one we miss is
a vote the other side earns.

We still need to raise another $14,138 before midnight to keep our
organizing, phone banking, and digital ads running until the polls close
tomorrow.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23014?t=1001&akid=933%2E245147%2ETpzPV0 ]So please, if it fits in your budget, will you pitch in any amount to
power our campaign across the finish line? If we don’t deliver a
resounding victory tomorrow, Donald Trump’s enablers will control EVERY
state-level office in Pennsylvania — and there will be no one left to
stand up to his attempts to undermine our most fundamental freedoms.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

Thank you,

Folks, this is it: Election Day is TOMORROW!
Have you voted yet? If not, stop what you’re doing and make a plan now. [**_iwillvote.com_**](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/225?t=3&akid=1257%2E127862%2E3SVyRt) has all the resources you need to make your voice heard:

— Team Ford

Let me guess: When you open up your email inbox, you're bombarded with emails from political campaigns or advocacy organizations, some of which you've never heard of.
_I know it 's a lot._
And it's why in a sea of promises that "Donald Trump is FINISHED" and breathless "5X MATCH NOW!!!" emails, I work really hard to make sure our messages are different.
No scammy tactics. No fake matches. Only real, honest updates about my work in the Senate and this reelection campaign in Georgia.
But here's the truth: The vast majority of donations we receive come from supporters just like you, who opened this email and decided to give a lot or a little to this campaign. It all adds up, and I couldn't be more grateful to every single one of you.
So yes, this is another email asking for money. I wish I didn't have to keep asking, but winning a Senate race in battleground Georgia takes a massive amount of resources. **[I hope you 'll join me by making a donation today.](https://substack.com/redirect/fc6a2b74-2eb1-4ff0-b9d6-28a30bd05385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Here's a link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-em-nov26](https://substack.com/redirect/fc6a2b74-2eb1-4ff0-b9d6-28a30bd05385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The Trump administration is out of control. They have lied us into war. They've sent prices skyrocketing.
They're abusing federal power. Every single day, the President and the First Family are lining their own pockets, to the tune of billions of dollars.
It has never been more important in American history that we restore checks and balances, because if we're not able to constrain and contain and slow down this attack on our Constitution, I don't know that we have free and fair elections in 2028.
And winning the Senate majority is essential to containing the catastrophic damage this administration is doing.
We have to defend this crucial Senate seat in Georgia. I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state that Donald Trump won. I can win again, but only with your help.
**[So please: Take a moment to donate $10 -- or whatever makes sense to you today -- to my reelection campaign. We'll put your donation straight to work getting out the vote like never before and decisively winning this Senate race.](https://substack.com/redirect/fc6a2b74-2eb1-4ff0-b9d6-28a30bd05385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CONTRIBUTE](https://substack.com/redirect/fc6a2b74-2eb1-4ff0-b9d6-28a30bd05385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you, thank you, thank you.
Jon

Tomorrow, hundreds of thousands of voters in CA-30 and across Southern California will have their ballots counted to decide the future of our country. And I want to remind you all what's at stake, one final time. As a Councilmember, Mayor of the City of Glendale, and as your representative in the State Assembly, I championed bold policies to create more affordable housing, protect our reproductive freedoms, and make California a model for environmental sustainability and clean renewable energy, even as big oil fought us. I’ve shown repeatedly that I can and will deliver for this community -- on the climate crisis, housing, healthcare access, and so much more. But I cannot do this alone. Peter,
Tomorrow is Election Day!
Throughout this campaign, I’ve been grateful to meet so many families across TX-21 and hear what matters most to them. Make life more affordable. Support small businesses. Keep Texans safe. Those will be my priorities in Congress.
The choice in this election couldn’t be clearer. Radical Democrats would make life more expensive, open our borders, and make our communities less safe. I’ll fight to lower the cost of living, cut taxes for hardworking families, and secure the border.
Now we have to finish strong. Turnout tomorrow is absolutely critical. Be sure to **VOTE and remind all of your friends!**

As if the Michigan Senate race could not get any more crazy.
Rep. Haley Stevens, who lost the Senate primary to Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed, shook the political world when she decided to endorse Republican Mike Rogers in the final stretch of the midterms.
Stevens went beyond a simple statement endorsing the GOP candidate, she went to a campaign stop with Rogers on the day she was supposed to be campaigning with El-Sayed.
The endorsement switch stems from El-Sayed's embrace of anti-Semetic tropes, campaigning with terrorist sympathizers, and reluctance to condemn Islamic terrorist organizations.

[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
This is a longer message from Jocelyn that we hope you’ll read to the
end, but if you’re short on time and want to make an impact in this
battleground race, [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25148?t=1001&akid=2136%2E181023%2EJyjy7Q ]will you chip in $5 or whatever you can before
Election Day tomorrow?

Hi there,

With Election Day tomorrow, I know you’re probably getting a lot of emails
from candidates like me about their last-minute GOTV efforts, so tonight I
wanted to send a different kind of email.

Before the craziness of Election Day kicks off, I wanted to take a minute
and reflect on why I’m running to be the next Governor of Michigan.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25149?t=1002&akid=2136%2E181023%2EJyjy7Q ][IMG]

I’m the daughter of two special education teachers who taught me that
everyone deserves a fair shot in life.

It’s why I started my career in Alabama working on civil rights and
investigating threats to democracy.

It’s why I became a law clerk in Detroit, fighting to protect and defend
people’s civil rights and freedoms.

It’s why, as Dean of Wayne State University Law School, I worked to ensure
all students could afford their education by freezing tuition and
expanding scholarships.

And it’s why, as Secretary of State, I’ve fought to make everyday life
easier for all Michiganders, secure our elections, and expand voter
access.

I know our work is far from finished — that’s exactly why I’m running for
governor.

At the end of the day, I’m running to be a governor who fights for you.

From cutting costs, raising wages, and ending the corruption that got us
here. I’ll fight for the veteran who deserves access to the healthcare
benefits they’ve earned. For the teachers who deserve better pay and more
respect.

For our kids whose future depends on what we do today.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25149?t=1003&akid=2136%2E181023%2EJyjy7Q ][IMG]

As a mom, I know just how important that is.

No matter what happens tomorrow, I will never stop fighting for the people
of Michigan. It’s what I’ve done as Secretary of State, and it’s what I’m
prepared to do as governor.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25149?t=1004&akid=2136%2E181023%2EJyjy7Q ]But first, I need your help one last time. Before polls officially open
tomorrow, will you please rush a donation tonight to help us finish this
race strong and keep reaching out to undecided voters? With hours to go
until this race is called, every single dollar counts.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

**Hello****–**** Ken Burns here.**
Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to Sherrod Brown’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Ohio. Winning this race is a must if we’re going to flip the Senate, so please join me in supporting Sherrod. **[Will you chip in $5?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142780722/658011061/-1024831887?amounts=250,100,50,25,5,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6641&refcode2=a5eecb6c-17d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWVlY2I2Yy0xN2Q3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ve93F6SMrIINCfna9g8jkur_IXLtsafyqNvuTYVAuwM=)**

People across the country are facing the same challenges – rising costs that make it hard to put food on the table, keep the lights on, and afford their medication.
These pressures are building up everywhere, and it’s up to us to do something about it.
**Sherrod has proven that he can not only meet this moment, but define it.**

Right now, there are those who want to steer Ohio – and much of the country – down a dark path. Using division as a tactic to gain power.

Republicans know the stakes of this race – it’s why they are sending millions into Ohio to tip the scales in their favor. And with this race rated as a Toss Up – with experts calling it the bellwether race for Senate control – what happens in this final day will decide everything.
**[It is an honor to stand beside Sherrod Brown and do everything I can to help elect him to the U.S. Senate – and I hope you’ll join me. If you can, please chip in $5 to help him win this crucial race.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142780723/658011062/-1024831887?amounts=250,100,50,25,5,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6641&refcode2=a5eecb6c-17d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWVlY2I2Yy0xN2Q3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ve93F6SMrIINCfna9g8jkur_IXLtsafyqNvuTYVAuwM=)**

Our seat, the 1st Congressional District, is one of the most competitive seats in the nation. We need every single commonsense voter to turn out, vote, and defeat the radical policies of our opponent
---
| |
# Who Is The Real Mitchell Berman?
---
| | Our opponent is a [**radical activist**](https://us.list-manage.com/r_Pw2de68BF?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc). While he is propped up by [**out-of-state,dark-money**](https://us.list-manage.com/19kVatrKnwT?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** that tries to cover up his record, the truth is far different than his ads portray.
My opponent’s actions [**triggered**](https://us.list-manage.com/NCApsYtMGXJ?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** an elementary school lockdown. Amid threats to staff, with kids inside, he confronted school officials. He was escorted out and the school went into lockdown. Right after the confrontation, he called into a local radio station and was [**TOO RADICAL**](https://us.list-manage.com/eEwfM4_bQSy?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) to be let on the air!
---
| [LISTEN HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/1A8PdMjfjMZ?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/lyYNsT3DH6G?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | My opponent [**opposed tax relief**](https://us.list-manage.com/3b2z1PMKNZf?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) for working families. Relief like no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, the new $6,000 senior deduction, the enhanced child tax credit and more.
My opponent [**supports free taxpayer-funded benefits for illegal immigrants.**](https://us.list-manage.com/aEyPEMX7O84?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) He’s willing to increase your taxes to pay for their benefits.
My opponent has called for [**defunding federal law enforcement**](https://us.list-manage.com/HxJ8DSs044H?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) , actions which would make our communities less safe.
My opponent has [**lied**](https://us.list-manage.com/emeZFpKYCog?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) about taking Corporate PAC money, [**lied**](https://us.list-manage.com/aYpSvdXCWDs?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** about our work to support healthcare in Wisconsin, and continues to [**mislead**](https://us.list-manage.com/GcjwRsThyc4?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** voters about my record.
Make no mistake, Mitchell Berman is a [**true radical**](https://us.list-manage.com/o_Q2sStxpzN?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc). He will say and do anything to win election. If he is misleading voters on these facts, what else is he hiding?
You can read our [**official voter guide here**](https://us.list-manage.com/FZnhO8jyu8v?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc). Or share a news outlet’s breakdown of Berman’s radical record [**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/rrbWVKp3moj?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**.**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/dZc92JvuzLN?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **How You Can Help?**
There are only a few hours left to make a difference. Here is how you can help:

* Vote TOMORROW
* Bring four people to the polls to vote Steil for Congress
* SHARE this email with your friends and family TONIGHT
* SHARE our [**Voter Guide Newsletter**](https://us.list-manage.com/K5kvXt7gmom?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) with your network
* SHARE the Voter Guide below:

---

Thank you for everything you’ve done so far, and everything you will do in the final hours of this race.
---
| | | | | | **On Wisconsin,** Bryan Steil

**Patriot, it’s John James. **
We're less than **48 HOURS** away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. _I promise I will not waste your time._
I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted.
I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, _**I would live it.**_
[**Eventually, this led me to apply to West Point, and my decision to serve my country would make me the man I am today.**](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/Y4o3KEN6tidt1az-KaNK7xkmphBb1L0zBiOEcUc7u1VDCmXdYTgiABWAPOx25T-XqnMTvtFmfHjQW7t3I2jvgh0qrp3HjjfpQK6f7s4aQW5lbCbR4jC4r_EpKXoWLPk3d4EkHGpU77N_Y3Aak2DCu3V27wkELpNr-jUsGDo8-V1cP2NKLqrHmZJlVthic-Fc4zj2VUaDuBxz2DDh0l6sGNpAOkVMY36j495mgMyD1HVDxsCoujs7G2xa8GPUevDn72oMv_wi1N84JCzIjyTCun4HeSIsgfvaxaxaalYtqkXuEfSjgW4xraq0YloxgxX04npPcPogM9xHKgVvOmKZAesHILmfDWkP3yaPokHCPMXqj4oU7nKvPP1VzfvL1XXWiY_3JI3AgwyQCYXQXe7FdDSmAP2Y7AvO79DmLECDeXYQ4hJOfm-ps0KPRi-ZHm2EVc6M1pRaVaRxmnVOuxrxnzEuvd9RqazdeU5EiaPnx8wHtbZjLe-rrhYpg7TQdkRfq2M4o3y5J1oTOg3CXU3fqk2am_-Sk6AicxbyCSY7jfixY-RcJQXL480o01lpNZ6q9TxG4aJr-8w_iP0Nl1unNFFjGJdqwfTKbiHgHAHoQf_9V5mX0mHphVlcC1MTAQ/C5zeBmHZaopZItPpjI1c6BIbg9gEMhHX/26)

Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army.
During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. **Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. **
**I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and _I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud._**

After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, **_I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. _**
I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician...

clean_body: It's almost Election Day.| | | | | Patriot, it’s John James. We're less than 48 HOURS away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a TRUMP-ENDORSED Republican and father running to be the next Governor of Michigan. Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming election for Governor on November 3rd. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. clean_body: | | | | Peter, Don't go to sleep on election night wishing you did more. That's the standard our Turning Point Action team is holding itself to. Right now, they're all gas, no brakes, and I couldn't be more proud of them. Everything this team is doing is more than just showing up right before November, because that's not what actually wins elections. It's about building real connections while reaching voters where they are, in their neighborhoods. It takes years of preparation, with our door-knockers building relationships and earning trust. This is what my husband built Turning Point Action to do. Charlie wanted voting to become a habit for every America-loving patriot in this country, and our team is making that dream a reality, one front door at a time. Here's a look at what our team is doing on the ground right now: ✅ Hosting over 500 Super Chase events nationwide up until Election Day, activating people to chase votes in their own communities. ✅ Training and deploying 850+ full-time ballot chasers across key states, with the number increasing by the day. ✅ Making sure voters in key states have a plan to submit their vote, through the work of our Chase the Vote team. ✅ Working day and night at headquarters so our field teams have everything they need to identify and reach every possible voter. ✅ Calling, texting, and writing postcards to voters, and hosting community events to get out the vote. ✅ Developing the "Freedom Ticket" as a personalized voter guide for patriots to use at the voting booth in key battlegrounds. ✅ Building permanent infrastructure in the new "Red Wall" states of Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire. Before I go any further, I want to say thank you. I’m a prosecutor, not a politician. I’d never run for office before, and I never took a single supporter for granted. President Trump endorsed this campaign, and folks from all across the country have helped carry it to this point. I’m grateful to every one of you. Tomorrow, the voters decide. Between now and then, supporters like you help decide how many of them we can still reach before they cast their ballot. Democrats have spent $11 million to stop me and spread lies about me. The Senate is decided one race at a time, and this is one of them. Every gift before Election Day helps us reach one more voter. Your support has meant the world to me. name: Maggie Hassan
subject: I'm committed to these three things:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH
body:
I'll never stop fighting. | My commitment to these three things remains unwavering:
1. Protecting access to health care,
2. Defending our fundamental rights, and
3. Calling out political corruption wherever I see it.

When I won my first U.S. Senate race by just 1,017 votes, I went on to stop Republicans from repealing the Affordable Care Act, _protecting healthcare for 28 million Americans_.

When Donald Trump nominated RFK Jr. to lead the Department of Health and Human Services, _I opposed his confirmation_ and have continued calling out his dangerous conspiracy theories and attacks on public health that undermine our safety.

And when reports raised serious questions about special access and potential corruption within the Trump administration, _I pushed for transparency and accountability_.

**I've never backed down from a fight when the health, safety, and rights of the American people were on the line. And I will keep fighting.**

Especially when Donald Trump has suggested canceling elections and recently refused to unconditionally commit to accepting the results of this one.

**Tomorrow is Election Day, and the stakes couldn't be higher.**

I'm not done fighting for the American people, and I hope you aren't either.
